notes.title: Bears in Tanks Day 1 Update
notes.content:
Our apologies, Bears in Tanks launched with a pretty rough bug: Obstacle movement was tied to framerate.
We've remedied the issue, enjoy elevators and pistons that move at moderate speeds.

notes.title: Bears in Tanks officially launched!
notes.content:
Dragonside Studios is proud to announce the launch of its first game: Bears in Tanks.

There's not much else to say, we hope you enjoy the game and share it with your friends!
